title: Implement issue lifecycle status tracking across rounds

The issue tracker manages finding status transitions (raised -> addressed -> verified -> closed, plus dismissed/reopened/acknowledged paths) across review rounds, enforcing valid transitions per spec Section 9.1.

- Status transitions match spec Section 9.1: raised->addressed, raised->dismissed, raised->acknowledged, addressed->verified, addressed->reopened, verified->closed (automatic), reopened->addressed
- Invalid transitions (e.g., closed->raised) return an error

title: Implement orchestrator crash recovery from persisted state

On restart, the orchestrator reads workflow-state.json, detects incomplete agent work, and resumes the workflow from the persisted state per spec Section 7.4 resumption protocol.

## Constraints
- Agent re-dispatch on resume counts against the retry budget
acceptance_criteria:
- ResumeWorkflow loads workflow-state.json and returns the current state
- If state is a gate state (HUMAN_GATE_1, HUMAN_GATE_2, HUMAN_GATE_FINAL), the gate is re-presented to the user
- If state is an agent state, the expected output file is checked: if present, workflow advances normally; if absent, the agent is re-dispatched (counting as a retry)
- Skill file checksums are compared; if changed since workflow start, a warning is logged but workflow continues

title: Implement parallel dispatch of four reviewer agents
description:
During the REVIEWING state, four reviewer agents are dispatched as concurrent CLI subprocesses, and the orchestrator collects all results (or failures) before advancing.

## Constraints
- Use the existing AgentBridge ClaudeAdapter for subprocess invocation
- Retry delay follows exponential backoff: 5s, 15s, 45s
acceptance_criteria:
- DispatchReviewers launches 4 goroutines, one per reviewer agent (clarity, consistency, security, correctness)
- All 4 results are collected before the function returns, using sync.WaitGroup or errgroup
- If 1 reviewer fails, the function retries that reviewer up to max_retries (2) times while holding the other 3 results
- If 1 reviewer fails after all retries, the function proceeds with 3 results and logs a warning including which lenses have reduced coverage
- If 2+ reviewers fail after all retries, the function returns an error that triggers ESCALATED

title: Implement the workflow state machine with transition guards
description:
The state machine enforces all valid transitions from spec Section 7.1, rejects invalid transitions, and applies guards for gate correction limits and round bounds.

## Constraints
- Transitions are defined as a lookup table, not nested switch statements

acceptance_criteria:
- Transition HUMAN_GATE_1 -> DISCOVERY is allowed only when gate1_correction_count < max_gate_corrections (3)
- Transition HUMAN_GATE_2 -> DRAFTING is allowed only when gate2_redraft_count < 1
- Transition to REVIEWING is blocked when round > max_rounds

- Transition JUDGING -> FINALIZED occurs only when had_critical_findings is false

title: Implement convergence judge verdict processing with anti-gaming checks

- **issue_tracker** (`IssueTracker`): Current issue tracker state -- Source: internal/specworkflow/issues.go

- **convergence_test** (`Go test file`): Tests each pre-check condition and authority limit -- Dest: internal/specworkflow/convergence_test.go

## Constraints
- Pre-check is deterministic code, not LLM judgement

acceptance_criteria:
- Pre-check rejects PASS if any CRITICAL finding status is not closed or dismissed
- Pre-check rejects PASS if revision change log does not reference every CRITICAL/MAJOR finding ID
- Pre-check rejects PASS if any CRITICAL finding marked closed has empty sections_modified in the change log
- Pre-check rejects PASS if min_rounds (2) is not met
- Judge downgrades are rejected if > 2 per round, or reason_code is not one of: DUPLICATE_OF, OUT_OF_SCOPE, CONTRADICTED_BY_REQUIREMENT, REVIEWER_ERROR
- Judge dismissals are rejected if > 3 per round
- Cumulative downgrades+dismissals > 5 across all rounds triggers ESCALATED
- When pre-check fails, verdict is overridden to REVISE with log message per spec Section 9.2

title: Implement deterministic progress metric computation
description:
The orchestrator computes progress after each JUDGING phase using the three-condition definition from spec Section 9.3, and triggers ESCALATED if progress is FALSE for 2 consecutive rounds.

## Inputs
- **issue_tracker** (`IssueTracker`): Historical issue counts per round -- Source: internal/specworkflow/issues.go
- **spec_section_9_3** (`string`): Section 9.3 progress definition -- Source: docs/specs/adversarial-spec-system.md

- **progress_test** (`Go test file`): Tests each progress condition and consecutive-false escalation -- Dest: internal/specworkflow/progress_test.go

## Constraints
- Progress is a deterministic computation, not an LLM decision
acceptance_criteria:
- Progress is TRUE if open CRITICAL+MAJOR count in round N < round N-1
- Progress is TRUE if >= 50% of CRITICAL+MAJOR findings from round N-1 are closed (even if new findings raised)
- Progress is TRUE if no CRITICAL findings remain open (even if MAJOR count unchanged)
- Progress is FALSE if none of the three conditions hold
- Two consecutive FALSE rounds triggers ESCALATED regardless of judge verdict
- If total open CRITICAL+MAJOR count increases for 2 consecutive rounds, ESCALATED is triggered (regression detection per spec Section 9.5)

title: Implement POST /api/workspace/upload endpoint with security controls
description:
The file upload API endpoint accepts multipart form data, validates file types and sizes per spec Section 16.1, sanitizes filenames, and stores files in the workspace source-docs directory.

## Inputs
- **spec_section_13_16** (`string`): Sections 13.3.1 and 16.1 -- Source: docs/specs/adversarial-spec-system.md

## Outputs
- **upload_handler** (`Go source file`): Multipart upload with all security controls -- Dest: internal/api/upload.go
- **upload_handler_test** (`Go test file`): Tests valid uploads, size limits, type restrictions, path traversal -- Dest: internal/api/upload_test.go

## Constraints
- All files stored under workspace/specs/{feature-name}/source-docs/
- Uses existing AgentBridge server.go HTTP handler registration pattern
acceptance_criteria:
- Accepts file types: .md, .txt, .pdf, .go, .ts, .py, .js, .yaml, .json (validated by extension AND content-type)
- Rejects files > 10 MB with 413 status
- Rejects total uploads > 50 MB per workflow with 413 status
- Rejects > 20 files per workflow with 400 status
- Filename sanitization strips path separators (/, \, ..), rejects null bytes, normalises to ASCII alphanumeric + hyphens + dots
- Path traversal prevention: final resolved path must be within workspace/specs/{feature}/source-docs/
- Content validation: .json files must parse as JSON, .yaml files must parse as YAML; mismatches rejected with 400
- Uploaded files appear in GET /api/workspace/files listing
